confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on crowd-sourced aggregator price pages (2023 to 2026 dates) and are cross-checked against each other. Cocktail and wine are weak: cocktail is bounded by Taipei bar ranges and a Kaohsiung spend-per-visit comparison, and wine is inferred from the local beer relationship with no direct price found. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge; no live listings were checked. The FX observation came from search summaries that cite RBA data, not a verified read of the live RBA table. Taiwan dollar conversions assume roughly 31 to 32 NT$ per USD.
comparable_city_reasoning: Kaohsiung is treated as a mid-sized Taiwanese port city priced below Taipei and broadly in line with Taichung. Restaurant and coffee levels follow Taichung and Taipei aggregator figures, adjusted down for Kaohsiung. Cocktail and wine use the local beer relationship. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for a mid-sized Taiwanese city.
